content:
We need to return all possible precursors of applying the template (from make_2_lvl2-template_search-1). The input gave mapped_rxn and template_id 1914385. We need to apply that template to the target molecule (initial_molecule: COC([C@]12CC=CC[C@H]1C(C2)=O)=O). Use apply_template with that template ID. Then output list of lists of precursor SMILES combos.

So call apply_template with molecule SMILES and template_id "1914385".
